expected_output.root_cause: Minimum spend threshold (₹2,000) is significantly higher than Spice Route Kitchen's median customer ticket size (₹850), creating spend barrier friction alongside geographic city mismatch (61.33% out-of-city targeting).
recommendations: ADJUST_THRESHOLD: Lower min_spend from ₹2,000 to an allowlisted threshold of ₹1,000 or ₹1,500 (keeping 10% cashback and ₹200 cap) after policy validation and historical replay simulation.
TARGETING_OVERHAUL: Restrict campaign delivery to customers residing in Pune.
MONITOR_VELOCITY: Track post-change redemption velocity and budget burn with mandatory human approval.
findings: Campaign CMP131 recorded a 4.0% redemption rate (6 of 141 delivered customers), below the 5.0% R1 threshold.
Merchant M001 historical spend profile shows median transaction amount ₹850 (average ₹882.32), far below the configured ₹2,000 minimum spend threshold.
Delivery metrics show 61.33% of targeted customers reside outside Pune, limiting in-person redemption.

expected_output.root_cause: Mid-campaign physical operational disruption (kitchen renovation recorded in merchant feedback FB045) caused redemption velocity to collapse by >= 50% in Period 2.
recommendations: PAUSE_CAMPAIGN: Pause campaign CMP310 during active store renovation or EXTEND_CAMPAIGN post-renovation.
MERCHANT_ESCALATION: Escalate operational disruption to the relationship manager; do not recommend passive KEEP.
findings: Period 2 redemption velocity dropped by more than 50% compared to Period 1 baseline for campaign CMP310.
Merchant feedback FB045 confirms kitchen renovation during mid-campaign, explaining the abrupt drop in in-store redemptions.
Customer reviews (e.g. REV108) corroborate service disruption or friction during the evaluation window.

expected_output.root_cause: New-customer acquisition campaign (ACQUIRE_NEW) is cannibalized by repeat patrons (>= 75% existing customer share) due to audience targeting leakage and an elevated trial spend barrier.
recommendations: TARGETING_OVERHAUL: Apply strict first-time shopper exclusion lists so repeat customers are excluded from ACQUIRE_NEW dispatches.
ADJUST_THRESHOLD: Lower trial min_spend to an allowlisted entry threshold (e.g. ₹1,000 or ₹1,250) validated via validate_proposal and simulate_campaign_change.
MERCHANT_ESCALATION: Audit POS coupon/code validation if in-store staff misuse is observed.
findings: Campaign CMP205 has objective ACQUIRE_NEW, but 82.0% of redeemers are pre-existing merchant customers, breaching the 75.0% R3 ceiling.
Audience delivery cohort failed to exclude historical transacting customers and/or set a high trial barrier.
